mapper.select: select count(seq) as cnt from tb_gallery

select seq, title, file_name, file_stored_name, writer, date_format(create_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_date, date_format(ifnull(update_date, create_date), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as update_date from tb_gallery order by seq desc limit #{offset}, #{rowCount}
mapper.insert: insert into tb_gallery(title, writer, file_name, file_stored_name, file_path, thumb_file_name, thumb_file_path) values( #{title}, #{writer}, #{fileName}, #{fileStoredName}, #{filePath}, #{thumbFileName}, #{thumbFilePath} )
